# GenRec AI

> GenRec AI is a product studio in Tamil Nadu, India. We design and engineer AI products, web apps and internal tools for teams that cannot afford a bad day. Strategy, interface and engineering stay in one small room.

GenRec AI was founded in 2023 and works as a three-person studio. We take one build at a time from the first failure-mode workshop to the final deploy, and stay for the first weeks after launch. Our work includes an open-source agentic database analyst, an AI study platform with more than 12,000 learners, QR ordering software for restaurants, and a faculty feedback system for VSB Engineering College.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.genrecai.com/): What GenRec AI builds, the six disciplines we carry, and how we work.
- [Work](https://www.genrecai.com/work): Four case studies with real users, live products and measurable outcomes.
- [SelectStar case study](https://www.genrecai.com/work/selectstar): An open-source agentic database analyst that answers questions in plain English with a six-agent graph instead of a ReAct loop.
- [LuminaIQ case study](https://www.genrecai.com/work/luminaiq): An AI study platform that turns a textbook into a prerequisite-ordered learning path, cited answers, quizzes, notes and flashcards.
- [Tabble case study](https://www.genrecai.com/work/tabble): QR ordering and a live kitchen display for restaurants, with no guest app and no order re-entry.
- [VSB Feedback case study](https://www.genrecai.com/work/vsb-feedback): A faculty feedback system for VSB Engineering College with student, HOD and administrator roles.
- [Studio](https://www.genrecai.com/studio): The three people, the four-step process and what we need from a client.

## Services

- Product strategy: scope, sequence and the one decision that makes the build smaller.
- Interface design: screens that hold up on a phone, a tablet and a bad connection.
- Full-stack engineering: web apps, APIs and the plumbing between them.
- AI systems: retrieval, evaluation and human review, with models where they earn their place.
- Data and infrastructure: schemas, queues, deploys and the quiet parts that keep a system up.
- Rescue and handover: taking over a stalled build, or leaving one a team can run.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2023
- Team: three people, based in Tamil Nadu, India, working worldwide.
- Focus: AI products, web applications, internal tools and data systems.
- SelectStar is live and open source under the MIT licence.
- LuminaIQ has more than 12,000 learners and 50,000 documents turned into study kits.
- Tabble is live with a founding cohort of restaurants.
- VSB Feedback runs in production at VSB Engineering College.
